defense_news.title: Pentagon looks to AI to identify space and missile threats
defense_news.summary: The Pentagon is seeking artificial intelligence that can cut through the confusion of missile defense.

defense_news.title: Saudi crown prince sought US military help with Houthis, sources say
defense_news.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman reportedly sought assistance from President Donald Trump on Thursday to help fight Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis.

defense_news.title: Polish prime minister: Poland to develop its own Starlink
defense_news.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said the project will pave the way for the launch of a Starlink-like system for the nation.

defense_news.title: US refutes claims that Iran captured Saildrone USV
defense_news.summary: A U.S. official denied the video shared by Iran purported to show an American Saildrone USV near the Strait of Hormuz in flames.
